settings.content: Five colors drive the whole shop. Everything else — hover states, borders, muted text — is worked out from these automatically.

settings.label: Ink
settings.info: Headings, navigation, and the footer. The deep navy from your artwork.

settings.label: Accent
settings.info: Buttons, prices, and badges. The orange from your artwork.

settings.label: Gingham
settings.info: The powder blue used for dividers and small accents.

settings.label: Photo shape
settings.info: Pin suits round buttons. Switch to Card if you start selling stickers, prints, or anything that isn't round.

settings.label: Show your shop name on each card
settings.info: Off by default — every product is yours, so repeating the name on each card adds noise.

settings.label: Fade content in as it scrolls
settings.info: Always disabled automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce motion.

settings.label: Link preview image
settings.info: The picture shown when someone pastes a link to your shop into Instagram, Facebook, or a group chat. Product and collection links use their own photo instead. Best at 1200 × 630.

settings.content: Leave a field empty to hide that icon. Paste the full address, including https://
